title: Streaming not working on first load / hard refresh (fixes after fast-refresh) on local dev
body:
### Description

Text Streaming is not working on first page load / hard refresh on nextjs in development mode.
If I send a message asking for a long response after a hard refresh, the network streaming tab shows the chunks coming in, but the `messages` array from useChat only updates with the first step-start and state: streaming, and then at the very end with the final message.

If I leave the page open and cause an update with Fast Refresh, then streaming works properly until I reload the page.

If the model makes tool calls before responding, the first tool call gets parsed in the messages array with "input-streaming". Then streaming stops being parsed, and the next update to `messages` contains the full tool call, it's output, any other tool calls and the final text response with state: "done".

Streaming works as expected after a hot/fast reload (If I add a console.log and then save)

Tested on Chrome, Safari, Arc

### AI SDK Version

ai-sdk/react: 2.0.0-beta.22
ai: 5.0.0-beta.22
next: 15.3.4

linked_prs.title: fix(ai-sdk/react) Add options.id to subscribeToMessages callback dependency array
linked_prs.body:
## Background

When useChat is mounted with id=undefined and the ID is updated later (e.g., from a backend fetch), streaming responses fail to display in real-time. The UI only updates after the entire response is received, even though the network shows chunks arriving correctly.

## Summary

Fixed stale subscription callbacks in useChat hook by adding the chat ID (if available) to the dependency array of the messages subscription callback.

## Verification

Built and tested locally in my app
